question: Why can improved isolated substitutions produce worse combined causal fidelity, and how does this differ by task/site?
data: Existing M93 whole-task and source-group full response vectors only; no new native forwards, fits, subsets or tasks
cases: All119 models, every eligible endpoint/site including full and identity controls; preserve weak/ineligible records and all51 raw/scaled comparisons

definitions.R00: Native background/native change response (teacher), each response centered on its own unchanged background
definitions.weight: Native baseline probability, identical across corners for an endpoint

measurements: Squared weighted norms of A,B,I and totalE
All signed cross terms 2<A,B>,2<A,I>,2<B,I>; report energy identity ||E||²=||A||²+||B||²+||I||²+cross terms
Counterfactual additive-error vector A+B (diagnostic algebra, not an executed model intervention)
Raw to scaled change in each energy/cross term; separate smaller isolated errors from loss of cancellation or larger finite interaction
Reproduce original M93 corner errors and total response errors; native full numerical-control residuals retained, not forced to zero
aggregation: Raw per-condition energies; pooled target-energy normalization and equal-family ratios consistent with M93. No per-example floor or deletion of tiny/zero teacher responses. Identity/null cases explicit, normalized fields null when denominator zero.
audit: Independent algebra and saved-logit rescoring. Vector identity maxabsolute<=1e-10, raw energy identities/replays rtol1e-7 atol1e-10. Keep failures and inspect conditioning rather than relaxing tolerances. Independently verify all aggregate sums.
interpretation: Opposing approximation-error vectors and downstream finite interaction are not native channel cancellation. Factorial contrasts depend on the chosen native/predicted coordinates and response metric; not a unique mechanistic decomposition or causal attribution of scalar error differences.
deliverable: One audited vector decomposition distinguishing error alignment, finite interaction and site-dependent change error; then choose whether future featurizer supervision needs joint consistency or conditional coordinate computation. No immediate loss/scale search.
stopping_rule: Complete one fixed all-case analysis and conceptual synthesis; return to a bounded featurizer/task-supervision decision.
